summary: Verified the ADMIN_RESET_PASSWORD fix on preview. Backend: 4/4 pytest cases passed - owner login OK (200, role=admin via /auth/me), wrong password returns 401, legacy admin@mikilab.de disabled (all attempts return 401), unauth /auth/me returns 401. Frontend: ?admin=1 shows simplified AuthScreen with only email/password (no Google/register/PIN/invite/forgot). After login with owner credentials the admin app renders and data-testid=account-btn appears (labeled 'MikiLab'). Login response 200. Fix works end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 12065 lines - should be modularized (auth reset, seed, routes into separate modules).
ADMIN_RESET_PASSWORD in .env should be rotated/removed after first admin login in production; owner already stated intent (idempotent, can be removed after access).

Legacy admin demotion uses $unset password_hash but does not clear other admin-only fields (e.g., stale sessions/tokens if any); currently OK since account has role=user, but consider invalidating outstanding sessions.
seed_data_creation: None. Reset logic in server.py startup used existing env var.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression tests at /app/backend/tests/test_admin_login.py. Note for UI testing: React controlled inputs on AuthScreen need page.keyboard.type() instead of page.fill() to reliably trigger onChange in Playwright; using fill() alone made the form submit-with-empty-state observation misleading in first iteration.
rca of the issue: Original bug: OWNER_EMAILS included multiple entries and legacy admin@mikilab.de retained admin+password, blocking owner michelecip918@gmail.com. Fix in server.py startup: (1) OWNER_EMAILS restricted to only michelecip918@gmail.com; (2) on startup if ADMIN_RESET_PASSWORD env is set, upsert owner user with role=admin+hashed password, wipe login_attempts for owner, demote admin@mikilab.de to role=user and unset password_hash, wipe legacy login_attempts. Verified: owner login now 200, legacy login 401, /auth/me returns admin role.
